title: Small Businesses Use AI to Help Workers, Not Replace Them
subtitle: While many fear technology will take away jobs, small business owners are using it to support their staff and grow their companies.

summary.en: Many people worry that artificial intelligence will cause mass unemployment. However, small business owners are using AI to make their current employees more efficient. By automating boring paperwork, workers can focus on serving more customers. Data from government and payroll companies shows that small businesses are still hiring new staff. Experts believe that a shrinking workforce makes AI a tool for growth rather than a replacement for humans.
summary.zh: 許多人擔心人工智慧將導致大規模失業。然而，小型企業主正利用人工智慧提升現有員工的效率。透過自動化處理繁瑣的文書工作，員工能專注於服務更多客戶。來自政府與薪資管理公司的數據顯示，小型企業仍在持續招募新員工。專家認為，勞動力縮減使得人工智慧成為成長的工具，而非人類的替代品。

paragraphs.en: When people talk about artificial intelligence (AI), they often focus on the fear that robots will take over human jobs. While large corporations sometimes use technology to cut costs and reduce staff, the story on Main Street is very different. Many small business owners are using AI to help their existing employees do more work, make fewer mistakes, and serve more customers.
paragraphs.zh: 當人們談論人工智慧時，往往聚焦於機器人將取代人類工作的恐懼。雖然大型企業有時會利用科技來削減成本並裁減人力，但一般小型企業的情況卻大不相同。許多小企業主正利用人工智慧協助現有員工提升工作量、減少錯誤，並服務更多客戶。

paragraphs.en: According to The Guardian, small businesses are moving beyond simple tasks like writing emails. They are now using AI in practical ways to improve daily operations. For example, one business owner who sells windows and doors invested in an AI application for his showroom. The software listens to conversations between salespeople and customers to automatically create price quotes. This allows the staff to spend less time on paperwork and more time talking to clients. Another business owner connected an AI tool to her company’s technical manuals. Now, her customer-support team can get quick, accurate answers to difficult questions, which helps them solve problems much faster than before.
paragraphs.zh: 根據《衛報》（The Guardian）報導，小型企業正超越撰寫電子郵件等簡單任務，開始以實用的方式運用人工智慧來改善日常營運。例如，一位經營門窗銷售的企業主為其展示間投資了一款人工智慧應用程式。該軟體能監聽銷售人員與客戶間的對話，並自動生成報價單。這讓員工能減少處理文書工作的時間，將更多心力放在與客戶溝通上。另一位企業主則將人工智慧工具連結至公司的技術手冊，現在她的客戶支援團隊能針對困難問題快速獲得精確的解答，這協助他們比以往更迅速地解決問題。

paragraphs.en: These real-life examples show that for many small companies, AI is not a replacement for people. Instead, it is a way to support a team that is often already very busy. The Guardian reports that many business owners are using technology to help their workers be more productive, especially as those employees get older and move toward retirement.
paragraphs.zh: 這些真實案例顯示，對許多小型公司而言，人工智慧並非人類的替代品，而是一種支援團隊的方式，畢竟這些團隊往往早已忙得不可開交。《衛報》指出，許多企業主正利用科技協助員工提升生產力，特別是在這些員工年齡漸長並逐漸邁向退休之際。

paragraphs.en: There is also strong evidence that these businesses are not planning to stop hiring. In fact, many are growing. The Department of Labor has reported a 9% increase in the number of people employed since mid-2021. Furthermore, payroll companies like ADP, Gusto, and Paychex have all seen continued job growth among their smaller clients. Gusto specifically noted that small businesses plan to hire nearly one million recent graduates in the 2026 season. This is a slight increase from the previous year, showing that the demand for human talent remains high.
paragraphs.zh: 此外，也有強而有力的證據顯示，這些企業並未計畫停止招募新血。事實上，許多企業正處於成長階段。勞工部（Department of Labor）報告指出，自二零二一年年中以來，就業人數增加了百分之九。此外，如 ADP、Gusto 和 Paychex 等薪資管理公司，皆觀察到其小型客戶群的就業人數持續成長。Gusto 特別提到，小型企業計畫在二零二六年期間招募近一百萬名應屆畢業生。這比前一年略有增加，顯示對人才的需求依然強勁。

paragraphs.en: Why is this happening? One major reason is that there simply are not enough people to do all the work that needs to be done. The United States workforce is expected to get smaller over the next ten years because of an ageing population and lower birth rates. Industries like construction are especially desperate for workers. Because of this, business owners see AI as a way to help their current staff manage their workload better, rather than a way to get rid of them.
paragraphs.zh: 為什麼會這樣呢？一個主要原因是，目前的人力根本不足以完成所有待辦工作。由於人口老化與出生率下降，美國的勞動力預計在未來十年內將會縮減。營建等產業尤其急需人力。正因如此，企業主將人工智慧視為協助現有員工更妥善管理工作負擔的工具，而非裁員的手段。

paragraphs.en: Some experts have warned that AI will lead to millions of people losing their jobs. However, history suggests that humans are very good at adapting to new technology. New types of jobs are always being created. For instance, roles such as social media managers or mobile app developers did not exist twenty years ago. As the world changes, the way we work changes with it. People are not just going to stop working because technology improves; they will likely find new ways to use their skills in a changing economy.
paragraphs.zh: 部分專家曾警告，人工智慧將導致數百萬人失業。然而，歷史顯示人類非常擅長適應新科技。新的工作類型總是不斷被創造出來。例如，社群媒體經理或行動應用程式開發人員等職位，在二十年前根本不存在。隨著世界改變，我們的工作方式也隨之演變。人們不會因為科技進步就停止工作；他們很可能會在變動的經濟環境中，找到運用自身技能的新方法。

paragraphs.en: Looking ahead, it seems that small businesses will continue to use AI to solve problems and improve efficiency. As they adopt these tools, they are not looking to shrink their teams. Instead, they are looking for ways to handle more work with the people they already have. For the millions of workers employed by small businesses, which make up about half of the country’s workforce, the future does not look like a world without jobs. It looks like a world where technology and humans work together to achieve more.
paragraphs.zh: 展望未來，小型企業似乎將持續利用人工智慧來解決問題並提升效率。在採用這些工具的同時，他們並非尋求縮減團隊規模，而是尋求在現有人力基礎上處理更多工作的方法。對於在小型企業工作的數百萬名員工而言——這些企業約佔全國勞動力的一半——未來並非一個沒有工作的世界，而是一個科技與人類攜手合作以達成更多成就的世界。

keyTerms.definitionEn: To gain control of something or replace someone in a job or position.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作「接管」，這裡指取代人類的工作。文中：they often focus on the fear that robots will take over human jobs.

keyTerms.definitionEn: Used to refer to ordinary people, small businesses, and the local economy, as opposed to large corporations.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 指代一般大眾、小型企業或在地經濟（相對於大企業）。
keyTerms.noteZh: 這裡並非指特定的街道，而是指代小型企業界。文中：While large corporations sometimes use technology to cut costs and reduce staff, the story on Main Street is very different.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To be approaching a particular stage or time in the future.
keyTerms.noteZh: 這裡指接近退休的年齡階段。文中：The Guardian reports that many business owners are using technology to help their workers be more productive, especially as those employees get older and move toward retirement.

keyTerms.definitionEn: Feeling or showing a great need for something.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 極度渴望的、迫切需要的。
keyTerms.noteZh: 容易被誤讀為「絕望的」，但在這裡表示對勞工有極大的需求。文中：Industries like construction are especially desperate for workers.

sources.name: The Guardian Technology
sources.title: Corporate America may be using AI to cut jobs, but small businesses are using it to keep them

quiz.question: According to the article, how do small business owners specifically use AI in their showrooms?

options.A: They use it to replace human salespeople with automated robots.
options.B: They use it to listen to customer interactions and generate price quotes.
options.C: They use it to write emails to potential clients automatically.
options.D: They use it to train new employees on how to sell windows and doors.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第二段，文中明確提到一位銷售窗戶和門的企業主，利用 AI 軟體監聽銷售人員與客戶的對話，並自動建立報價單（price quotes）。選項 A 錯誤，因為文章強調 AI 是輔助而非取代人類；選項 C 雖然提到電子郵件，但那是文中提到的另一種簡單任務，並非 showroom 的應用；選項 D 文中並未提及 AI 用於培訓新員工。

quiz.question: What can be inferred about the relationship between AI adoption and the aging workforce in small businesses?

options.A: AI is being used to force older employees to retire earlier than planned.
options.B: AI is making it unnecessary for businesses to hire younger workers.
options.C: AI helps maintain productivity levels as the existing workforce ages.
options.D: AI is only effective for younger employees who are comfortable with technology.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。文章第三段提到，企業主利用科技幫助員工提高生產力，特別是當員工年齡增長並接近退休時。結合第五段提到的人口老化與勞動力短缺問題，可以推論出 AI 被視為一種工具，用來彌補勞動力減少或體力下降帶來的生產力缺口，讓現有員工能持續發揮效能。選項 A 與文意相反；選項 B 與第四段提到的持續徵才事實不符；選項 D 文中並未提及 AI 對年齡層的限制。

quiz.question: In the final paragraph, what does the word 'shrink' mean in the context of small businesses?

options.A: To reduce the size or number of something.
options.B: To hide or conceal from the public.
options.C: To fail to complete a difficult task.
options.D: To change the focus of a business strategy.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。在最後一段中，作者提到企業主在採用 AI 工具時，並不是想要「shrink」他們的團隊，意指他們並不想裁員或縮減人力規模。在此語境下，shrink 指的是減少數量或規模。選項 B、C、D 皆不符合該動詞在商業管理語境下的定義。此題旨在測試學生在閱讀長篇論述時，理解動詞在企業人力資源管理中的具體含義。

quiz.question: What is the central message of the article regarding AI and small businesses?

options.A: AI will eventually cause a massive decline in the number of jobs available.
options.B: Small businesses are struggling to keep up with large corporations in AI adoption.
options.C: AI is a tool that helps small businesses increase efficiency without replacing human workers.
options.D: The government is forcing small businesses to use AI to solve labor shortages.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。整篇文章的核心論點在於，儘管外界擔憂 AI 會導致失業，但在小企業中，AI 被視為提升現有員工生產力的輔助工具，而非裁員手段。文章透過實際案例、勞動數據及未來趨勢分析，強調了人機協作的正面價值。選項 A 是文章反駁的觀點；選項 B 文中並未比較大小企業的競爭力；選項 D 錯誤，政府報告僅是數據來源，並非強制命令。
